title: Depth-progressive 3D seismic velocity model building via 2D generative diffusion models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) velocity model building (VMB) remains computationally challenging with conventional approaches and native 3D neural networks, largely due to the prohibitive memory and training cost of full 3D formulations. Therefore, we introduce a depth-progressive framework that achieves 3D VMB using 2D generative diffusion models through a depth-as-channel formulation, in which the depth dimension of each 3D velocity patch is mapped to the channel dimension of a 2D U-Net. This allows the model to synthesize overlapping depth patches sequentially from shallow to deep while conditioning the prediction of the deeper patch on the shallower one, as well as on any available geophysical constraints, including well logs and structural attributes. translated_title: 基于二维生成扩散模型的深度渐进式三维地震速度模型构建
translated_abstract: 三维（3D）速度模型构建（VMB）在使用传统方法和原生三维神经网络时仍然面临巨大的计算挑战，这主要是由于完整三维公式化所需的内存和训练成本过于高昂。因此，我们提出了一种深度渐进式框架，通过“深度作为通道”的公式化设计，利用二维生成扩散模型实现三维速度模型构建，其中每个三维速度片块的深度维度被映射到二维U-Net的通道维度。这使得模型能够从浅到深依次合成相互重叠的深度片块，同时将较深片块的预测条件化于较浅的片块以及任何可用的地球物理约束之上，包括测井资料和构造属性。在训练过程中，使用具有随机重叠的浅-深配对片块来教导网络学习更深部速度结构与浅部信息之间的关联，并采用无分类器（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种深度渐进式框架，通过将三维速度片块的深度维度映射为二维U-Net的通道维度，利用二维生成扩散模型在测井等地球物理约束下从浅到深逐层合成三维地震速度模型，从而避免了原生三维网络高昂的内存与训练成本。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a depth-progressive framework that maps the depth dimension of 3D velocity patches onto the channel dimension of a 2D U-Net, using 2D generative diffusion models to sequentially synthesize 3D seismic velocity models from shallow to deep under geophysical constraints, thereby avoiding the prohibitive memory and training costs of native 3D networks.
